My mother, who is 60 years old, visited Ayushakti Ayurved Health Centre in Dadar West for knee pain treatment. Their doctor told us that the fluid in her knee (joint effusion) would return to normal and the pain would go away after treatment. They charged around ₹70,000 and asked us to take X-rays before and after the treatment to show the “improvement.”

For one month, they advised her to stop eating non-veg food and even restricted some veg food without any reason or alternatives.How can patient eat moong all days?

After one month, my mother took another X-ray, but there was absolutely no improvement. We then decided to take a second opinion from an orthopedic doctor. After checking both the “before” and “after” X-rays, the doctor explained that the clinic had asked for different X-ray angles/views, which can naturally make the images look different even without any actual improvement. He said this is a common way to mislead patients.

The worst part was that after paying such a huge amount, we couldn’t even question them properly. Whenever we asked anything, they gave scripted answers like, “You have to trust our medication.”

In my personal experience, this treatment was a complete waste of money. If you have plenty of money, you can try it at your own risk. But if you don’t want to waste your hard-earned money, please think carefully before going ahead.

God bless you if you are reading this after already making the payment.

In allopathy, the usual treatment options are exercise, painkillers, or surgery. Since the last two are not suitable for long-term relief, I started searching for an Ayurvedic solution and visited a few reputed clinics, including JIVA Ayurveda.

When I first met Dr. Kshirsagar,  at JIVA, he patiently listened to my condition and explained the Ayurvedic approach in detail. He clarified that while MRI results might not show visible improvement or the disc may not “go back in,” the pain and symptoms can be effectively managed through Ayurveda. Dr. Shrissagar also mentioned that results vary from person to person — some patients recover completely, while others may need continued treatment depending on the body’s response. I decided to proceed with the treatment.

The Panchakarma sessions were conducted by Shri Nilesh, who is a genuinely humble and dedicated therapist. Shri Nilesh is very experienced and knows exactly how to make patients comfortable. Thank you, Nilesh ji, for your care and professionalism.

During the sessions, he also explained the importance of a positive attitude and Ayurvedic lifestyle practices. Even when he was unwell one day, he still came to complete my session — that shows his commitment and sincerity.

My tingling sensation has reduced by about 80%, and my overall pain has also decreased noticeably. I feel less stressed and more active now.

💡 My Understanding of the Treatment

In Ayurveda, back and nerve problems are generally linked to an imbalance of Vata Dosha. The Panchakarma treatment helps pacify Vata, reduce inflammation, and strengthen the nerves.

Many people have disc bulges but don’t experience pain — this is because their nerves are strong and there is less internal inflammation. Ayurveda focuses on achieving that balance rather than simply fixing the disc. When inflammation reduces and nerves become stronger, the pain and tingling symptoms subside naturally.

It’s also important to continue exercises, follow a healthy diet, and maintain positive habits to support long-term recovery. Reading more about Ayurvedic principles and adjusting one’s lifestyle can further enhance the results.
